label: batch-44
tail:
Batch 44 is drafted: six A-page items cover the BV bracket, Lie-action BRST complex, and classical/formal quantum master equations; three B-page items provide a counterexample and two worked examples.

Scoped checks passed: rendering of all 11 files, proof layout (9 items, 23 steps, 0 defects), precheck (6/6), strict proof contracts, manifest dependencies, content policy, coverage (20 results), and source retrieval (8/8). Focused depcheck had 0 errors and 2 expected warnings for links from definitions to later theorems.

All nine Step 1 records are escalated and hash-current. PA12’s required page route has no item bodies to inspect; the batch notes and cross-batch ledger record this without inventing item dependencies or excerpts. PA10’s DGA context was compared and not used as a logical supplier.

Files: [A page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/homological-algebra/bv-brst-and-homological-physics-interfaces.md>), [B page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/homological-algebra/bv-brst-and-homological-physics-interfaces-examples.md>), [manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-44.pages.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-44.proof-contracts.json>), and [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-44.notes.md>).

Two accidental `depcheck --help` invocations ran read-only full-corpus scans; those results were excluded from the scoped evidence and are documented in the notes.
